page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the printed page number at top right and the running head at top left. A rule divides the upper part from the lower section. A final signature mark sits at the lower right. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: Libertinorum status tripertitus antea fuer[?]t. Nam
qui manumittebantur, modò majorem & justam li-
bertatem consequebantur & fiebant cives Romani:
Modò minorem & Latini ex lege Julia Norbana fie-
bant: Modo inferiorem: & fiebant ex lege Aelia Sen-
tia Dediticii. §.libertinorum.inst.eod.
Hodie vero est unum tantum genus libertinorum,
qui fiunt cives Romani: Reliqua duo genera Impe-
rator duabus Constitutionibus sustulit.l.cùm dediti-
cii. C.de Latin.libert.tollend.&
l.deditilia[?]. C.de deditilia liber.tollend.
QUIS EST SEXTUS
Titulus?
Quibus ex causis manumittere non licet.
NOn tamen cuicunque volenti, manumittere licet.
Nam is qui in fraudem creditorum manumittit,
nihil agit: quia lex Aelia Sentia impedit libertatem. in
princ.inst.eod.

l.i: Potestne Dominus, qui solvendo non est, in tes-

main_text.l: Licet Domino qui solvendo non est, in testamen-
to servum suum cum libertate haeredem instituere,
ut liber fiat, haeresque ei solus & necessarius: si modò
ei nemo alius ex eo testamento haeres extiterit. §. li-
cet.inst.eod.

page.notes: The "u" in "fuerat" is partly obscured by a blot; read as "fuer[?]t" with the letter unclear. "deditilia" in the second paragraph is not clear; the word may read "deditia" or similar. The page number 433 is printed at top right and is partly faint. The black letter German line is set in a different type and was copied as printed. The signature "E" is at the lower right.
